name: Public Distribution System (National Food Security Act, 2013)
summary: Provides subsidised foodgrains to eligible households through Fair Price Shops under the National Food Security Act, 2013. Priority Households (PHH) and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families receive monthly entitlements.

eligibility_clauses.text: The household must hold a valid ration card classified as either Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (PHH).
The applicant must be a resident of the State/UT where the ration card is issued.
A household that pays income tax or is covered under a statutory income-tax category is excluded from Priority Household coverage.

entitlement_rules.text: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) households receive 35 kg of foodgrains per household per month.
Priority Household (PHH) families receive 5 kg of foodgrains per person per month.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First appeal against rejection or card correction at the district level.
Second appeal to the State Food Commission if the district decision is unsatisfactory.
